UNetWriters.pas::EachPart.text: Visits the placed symbols of every sheet in drawing order and calls Add for each; with OnlyFirst, a symbol whose reference has already been visited is skipped (the writers' set of references already written).

params.Add: called with each symbol and its reference

USpiceVhdl.pas::TOrdMap.Search.text: Binary search for a key among the sorted keys (compared by character code, as CString's operator< does). Index is where the key is, or where it would be inserted.

params.Index: its position, or the position to insert it at

USpiceVhdl.pas::TOrdMap.Has.text: True if the key is in the map.

USpiceVhdl.pas::TOrdMap.Get.text: std::map's operator[]: the value stored for the key; a key that is not there is added with the default value (an empty string, 0 or nil) and that default is returned.

USpiceVhdl.pas::TOrdMap.SetValue.text: Stores a value for a key, adding the key if it is not there.

USpiceVhdl.pas::TOrdMap.KeyAt.text: The key at a position in key order.

USpiceVhdl.pas::TOrdMap.ValueAt.text: The value at a position in key order.

USpiceVhdl.pas::DefaultWithExtension.text: The design's file name with its last extension replaced by Ext; a name with no dot gives output followed by Ext.

params.DesignFile: the design's file name, empty if it has none

USpiceVhdl.pas::VhdlDefaultFileName.text: The name the Create VHDL file dialog proposes: the design's name with .vhd, or output.vhd.

USpiceVhdl.pas::SpiceDefaultFileName.text: The name the Create Spice Net List dialog proposes: the design's name with .net, or output.net.

USpiceVhdl.pas::CollectMethods.text: Puts every placed symbol of the design, sheet by sheet in drawing order, in a list (the C++ walks them with componentsBegin and componentsNext).

USpiceVhdl.pas::TSpiceSymbol.Create.text: CNetListSymbol: a symbol with no pins yet.

params.AFileIdx: the file index (0, the root design)

USpiceVhdl.pas::TSpiceMaker.NetKey.text: The key under which a net number is kept in the maps.

USpiceVhdl.pas::TSpiceMaker.GetAttr.text: CNetList::get_attr: "refnum" and "ref" give the symbol's reference (the reference path of a symbol of the root design is its reference); any other name is looked up among all the fields of the symbol, ignoring case.

USpiceVhdl.pas::TrimWhite.text: CString::Trim: removes white space from both ends.

mainform.pas::SaveTextFile.text: Writes a text to a file, replacing it; False if the file cannot be written.

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.SpiceProposedName.text: The name the Create Spice Net List dialog proposes: the design's name with .net, or output.net for a design with no dot in its name.

mainform.pas::TfrmMain.VhdlProposedName.text: The name the Create VHDL file dialog proposes: the design's name with .vhd, or output.vhd for a design with no dot in its name.

nettest.pas::DoNodes.text: Test mode: prints every node of every net in net order, as NODE, net, label, preferred label, reference, pin, then P and the pin's name, number and electrical type (or N and three dashes when the node is not a pin), then the sheet number (from 1) and the placed symbol the node belongs to as sheet:number (or a dash).

netwtest.pas::WriteTextFile.text: Writes a text to a file.

netwtest.pas::DoVhdl.text: Test mode: writes the VHDL file of a design as it would be written to PathName (which names the entity), with line feeds.

params.PathName: the file name given to the writer

netwtest.pas::DoSpice.text: Test mode: writes the SPICE file and its error text with line feeds, and prints R and the number of errors.

params.Stamp: the date and time for the first line
params.Heading: the design name in the error text

netwtest.pas::DoHelpers.text: Test mode: runs the helpers of the SPICE and VHDL writers on the lines of a file and prints each answer as R followed by the result. A line is the kind (atoi, bus, decl, ref, entity, vdefault, sdefault, errname or stamp), the text and a third value, separated by tabs.
